forgetting_analysis.note: With gamma=0.997, effective memory is ~333 steps. After 100% burn-in (1785 steps), warmup priors are decayed by gamma^1785 = 4.69e-03. The 0% condition is the only one where priors are fully intact at the start of test.

hparams.pacer_pre_calibration: For budget-constrained conditions the pacer is pre-calibrated on the full val set (routing with the initial policy, costs observed, bandit NOT updated).  All burn-in fractions start from an identical lambda_t snapshot.
